buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web && sed -i 's/<body>/<body style="background-color:#050505">/' dist/index.html && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="en" style="background-color:#050505">/' dist/index.html

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co https://api.anthropic.com https://auth.truelayer.com https://api.truelayer.com; img-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-src https://auth.truelayer.com
